Electricity at Yuelamu is supplied to all customers at the Northern Territory standard tariff and standard connection charges apply. Yuelamu is connected to the Yuendumu electricity grid.

Yuelamu is currently provided with treated drinking water collected by residents from an advanced water treatment plant that is connected to a non-potable bore. Non-potable water for hygiene only usage is supplied to residents through the existing water reticulation system. A dual reticulation system to supply both potable and non-potable water to households is currently under construction. The surface water dam which previously supplied the community with potable water is unusable due to long term contamination from blue green algae.
Yuelamu has a fully reticulated sewerage system.
Anmatyerr / Warlpiri
Central Desert Regional Council
Stuart
Yuelamu is located north west of Alice Springs on the Yalpirakinu Aboriginal Land Trust south of Mount Denison Pastoral Property.
